== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Patman]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]

== Introduction ==

A standard LS Saber Combat deck. Has not been played as of this posting. I'm curious what you think of it!

== Strategy ==

Heh. Well, since I haven't had a chance to play this deck yet, strategy is sketchy, at best. The plan is to set up a Jedi at each major Naboo battleground in the deck, and use the other characters to pursue and smack the opponent elsewhere. A variety of lightsabers allows for some flexibility: do I need to add to drains, or enhance saber combat? Many high destinies; much more than I usually manage. Use the "Binks Bomb" on the omnipresent Destroyer Droids, Guri, etc. Electropoles can be either used (and recycled!) or made into combat destiny. Soon, I hope to know how this deck holds up. Thanks for reading!
